title: The emoji setting now survives closing the app
summary: A follow-up to 0.2.34, found by restarting the app on a phone rather than trusting the code: the option that removes images of living beings from the emoji picker only took effect while the app stayed open. After a restart the full set came back, and the only way to get the filtered one again was to toggle the switch off and on.

changes.title: The emoji filter is applied at startup, not only when the switch is touched
changes.description: The emoji provider decides which categories exist at the moment it is installed, and the app installed it before reading the setting — so on every launch the unfiltered set was built, and the preference was read a fraction of a second too late. The setting is now read first, in both places the provider is installed, so a restart keeps what was chosen.
